name: Great Weapon Fighting
entriesHtml: When you roll damage for an attack you make with a melee weapon that you are wielding with two hands, you can treat any roll of 4 or less on a damage die as a 5. The weapon must have the 2H||two-handed or V||versatile property for you to gain this benefit.

name: Protection
entriesHtml: When a creature you can see hits you or a target other than you that is within 5 feet of you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to add your proficiency bonus to the target's AC for that attack, potentially causing the attack to miss. You must be wielding a shield or a F||finesse weapon.
